title: MV Where to find attack animations and sound effects.

posts.author: BluAidan
posts.body: So I have been trying to find some good attack animations to use but it is somehow hard to find those around the internet. The animations that I come across are mostly from Dream Circle, the particle effect pack on Steam, and the bundle that Avery recently posted, and thats about it. As for sound effects, the ones that I found online didn't really fit the animations that I was using. Also I found a reddit post with a list of animations to get, but those are just gone for some reason. If possible, could you please try and help me find some. Thank you. :]

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: Try searching itch.io for vfx and sfx

I've looked on itch.io but I genuinely cannot find anything that works for my game on there. There is ManuGamingCreations's animations but that is all I can find in itch.io, everything else is just 8 bit animations for games that is not really related to battles. Sorry :[

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Where to find more animations!
With a lot of help by dear slimmeiske2, I now finally set up a list where you can find battle animations for all your needs!  I am open for new sources, so if you know something to expand the list leave a post  :)  A Artificial Providence - Translated terms B Bubble Blog C CalebW Cho/CHOGEMU -...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Might have deadlinks though and check the terms.
Each maker comes with animations and you can use XP and Ace ones in MV as well, sheets are the same size, so getting those when on sale would get you huge animation and sound packs.
